newsitem.title: UK: Old English Pub says Dec revenue higher.
newsitem.headline: Old English Pub says Dec revenue higher.

text.p: The Old English Pub Company said on Tuesday that its sales in December 1996 increased by 112 percent over the same period a year earlier.

The company said its hotel accomodation business increased its market share by just under four percent while its share in food business rose 47 percent. It gave no actual market share figures, however.
"On a like-for-like basis, our first 20 houses increased by 9.5 percent," it said in a statement.
Old English's recent acquisitions increased business by 4.5 percent.
"We are delighted with December trade in exceeding our plan and look forward to our year end in March," the statement said.
The share price of Old English was marked just two pence down at 214 -1/2 pence just before it announced its trading statement.
It has already acquired one more pub/restaurant which will start operations on January 13. It also plans to take over three more pubs/restaurants soon.
Old English currently has 66 pubs/restaurants with 460 letting rooms in 35 locations.
